verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's own site claims that, as a lightweight and efficient OS, installing it on older hardware can improve performance and extend device lifespan. This is a bare marketing statement with no supporting detail, and one community user reports leaving Ubuntu over bloat and crashes, citing better performance elsewhere, though not specifically on older hardware. missing for 10: documented hardware requirements or older-hardware guidance, benchmarks or performance evidence, hands-on corroboration on aging devices.
